behaviors.description: Include installed locale extensions in list output.
behaviors.preconditions: App, runtime and an explicitly installed independently known locale extension.
behaviors.expected: Default/all/default queries preserve exact app/runtime membership and show the hidden extension only with all.

behaviors.description: Show installed ref details through the all-columns alias.
behaviors.preconditions: Two independently prepared branches of the same app are installed.
behaviors.expected: Details equal columns=all, differ from ordinary output, and identify both installed branches and their independent commits exactly.

mappings.rationale: An installed locale is excluded in both ordinary controls and included in the all query.

surface_assertions.rationale: Exact list membership adds the known installed locale only with all.

mappings.rationale: All-columns equivalence and an ordinary-output contrast are backed by independent identity/commit assertions.

surface_assertions.rationale: Both installed branches appear with their known architectures and commits in the documented all-columns form.
